voice.summary: Shouts in neon capitals with a wink: arcade-cabinet language, high scores and sound-effect energy. It is loud and friendly, all quarters and combos.
dos: Use arcade phrases like insert coin and high score
Keep every line to a punchy burst

boilerplate: Last Quarter Arcade is a retro arcade bringing 1980s cabinets, a scrolling high-score table and neon style to a modern landing page.

logo.note: A coin is the heart of the arcade and the call to action.
